user.title: Connect to Distribuce24
user.description: Enter credentials generated in Distribuce24 under Account management → Remote access – OpenAPI. Meter selection follows. Display names are used for sensors and Energy statistics. They apply to all selected meters, distinguished by EAN.

data.include_export: Download energy exported to the grid

meters.title: Select electricity meters
meters.description: Select one or more meters. Only supported A, B and C1 meters are shown. Only selected meters will be downloaded.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew Distribuce24 credentials
reauth_confirm.description: New credentials must grant access to all previously selected meters.

hdo.title: HDO and prices – {ean}
hdo.description: Optionally enable NT/VT for this meter. Enter both prices in CZK/kWh on the same basis, e.g. including VAT. If multiple programs exist, select the meter tariff program; a water-heating relay can have different times. Use Reconfigure to change these settings later.

costs.title: Costs and history – {ean}
costs.description: Enter the total monthly fixed fee in CZK, using the same VAT basis as NT/VT prices. Without backfill, new prices apply from saving these settings. Backfill applies current prices and fees only where historical prices are missing, back to YYYY-MM-DD. Existing prices are preserved. Historical NT/VT depends on available HDO schedules; this is not a supplier bill.

data.backfill_prices: Fill missing historical prices with current values

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to EG.D. Try again later.
error.select_meters: Select at least one available meter.
error.invalid_hdo: Enter a valid postcode and HDO code.
error.invalid_price: Enter non-negative NT and VT prices in CZK/kWh.
error.unknown_postcode: Postcode not found in the EG.D catalog.
error.ambiguous_hdo: The program is ambiguous. Check the code and relay.
error.select_hdo_schedule: This code has multiple programs. Select the meter tariff program.
error.cannot_connect_hdo: Unable to download HDO. Retry later or disable HDO.
error.invalid_monthly_fee: Enter a non-negative monthly fixed fee.
error.invalid_backfill_date: Enter a valid YYYY-MM-DD date that is not in the future.

abort.already_configured: At least one selected meter is already configured.
abort.no_supported_meters: This account has no supported A, B or C1 meters.
abort.missing_selected_meters: New credentials do not provide access to all selected meters.
